sentences.text: In short: ODDA RUTEBUSS AS is an established company in "passasjertransport utenom rutetabell" based in Ullensvang, profitable in 2025 and with no open NAV job ads under its org number.
ODDA RUTEBUSS AS describes itself on its website as: "Våre komfortable turbussar med klimaanlegg, kjøleskap og toalett utfører små og store transportoppdrag over heile landet".
ODDA RUTEBUSS AS is a private limited company (AS), founded on 1979-12-12, registered in Ullensvang.
It reported revenue of NOK 9.41M for 2025 and an operating result of NOK 382,583 (2025).
Its 2025 accounts show an operating margin of 4.1% and a strong equity ratio of 49% of total assets.

Revenue fell 26.1% from 2024 to 2025 (NOK 12.73M to NOK 9.41M); it was NOK 12.64M in 2023. The annual result was a profit in each of the 3 filed years read (2023: NOK 326,606, 2024: NOK 387, 2025: NOK 125,717).
ODDA RUTEBUSS AS is led by Asbjørn Ystanes, who is both CEO and board chair.
The register last recorded a change to its roles on 2026-08-05 (within the past year).
ODDA RUTEBUSS AS has a verified website (https://www.odda-rutebuss.no/) and 1 registered workplace.
